title: Three Brillhart-Lehmer-Selfridge primality proofs for Wagstaff numbers
summary: The Wagstaff numbers $W_p = (2^p + 1)/3$ for odd primes $p$ are the natural $+1$ companions of the Mersenne numbers. Known primality proofs for $W_p$ with $p \geq 2617$ rely on the elliptic-curve primality proving algorithm of Atkin-Morain; Chebyshev/Lucas-type tests, while available as compositeness criteria, remain conjectural on the sufficiency side. We present fully verified primality proofs of $W_{2617}$ (788 digits), $W_{10501}$ (3161 digits), and $W_{12391}$ (3730 digits), independent of ECPP and relying only on classical $N-1$ machinery.
